question.text: A stream of electrons and protons are directed towards a narrow slit in a screen (see figure). The intervening region has a uniform electric field (vertically downwards) and a uniform magnetic field $\mathbf{B}$ (out of the plane of the figure) as shown. Then

options.text: electrons and protons with speed $\frac{|\mathrm{E}|}{|\mathbf{B}|}$ will pass through the slit
protons with speed $|\mathrm{E}| /|\mathrm{B}|$ will pass through the slit, electrons of the same speed will not
neither electrons nor protons will go through the sit irrespective of their speed
electrons will always be deflected upwards irrespective of their speed

solution.text: of their speed. And electrons will always be deflected upwards irrespective of their speed. So, (c) and (d) are correct options.
